LanguageData.RimSiege_TextFootAssault: A war party of {0} is setting up camp outside your walls, readying an assault on foot. No siege engines this time - hold the line and break their charge.
LanguageData.RimSiege_TextTower: A force of {0} is setting up camp outside your walls and raising a SIEGE TOWER. Once built, it will be pushed against your rampart to pour attackers over the top. Wreck their worksite before it's ready.
LanguageData.RimSiege_TextRam: A force of {0} is setting up camp outside your walls. They are building a BATTERING RAM to smash your gate. Sally out and sabotage the worksite - kill the builders, burn their blueprints and supplies - or get ready to hold the breach.
LanguageData.RimSiege_TrebOne: A trebuchet will support the assault from a distance.
LanguageData.RimSiege_TrebMany: A battery of {0} trebuchets will pound your walls from a distance.
LanguageData.RimSiege_BallistaHint: Ballistas will guard their camp - a sally will ride into bolt fire.
LanguageData.RimSiege_BombardBegins: The siege engines are complete. The bombardment begins.
LanguageData.RimSiege_SappersHint: Sappers will try to blow a second breach elsewhere in your wall.
LanguageData.RimSiege_CaptainHint: Their captain, {0}, leads the host - look for the gilded helm and his two bodyguards. Bring him down early and the siege will collapse.
LanguageData.RimSiege_CaptainFell: {0} has fallen - the besiegers lose heart and break camp!
LanguageData.RimSiege_UltimatumText:
A force of {0} has made camp within reach of your walls and demands a tribute of {1} silver.

Pay, and they will break camp without a fight - nothing will besiege you.
Refuse (or let the deadline pass), and the siege begins: they will build their engines and march on your walls.

You have a few hours to decide.
LanguageData.RimSiege_NotEnoughSilver: Not enough silver in your home area or storage ({0} needed, {1} on hand).
LanguageData.RimSiege_LateLabel: Last offer: tribute or the walls
LanguageData.RimSiege_LateText: {0}'s engines stand ready. Their envoy makes one last offer: {1} silver, and the host breaks camp and leaves its machines where they stand.\n\nThe price has gone up. So has the cost of refusing.
LanguageData.RimSiege_LateTributePaid: Late tribute paid ({0} silver). {1} breaks camp and abandons the siege engines.
LanguageData.RimSiege_LateTooLate: Too late - they are already inside your walls.
LanguageData.RimSiege_ReinforceText: {0} more fighters have marched in to join {1}'s siege camp.
LanguageData.RimSiege_UltimatumPaidBefore: \n\nWord of your gold has spread. The price has gone up.
LanguageData.RimSiege_RansomText:
{0} wants their captain back. {1} sits in your jail, and his house offers {2} silver for his safe return.

Accept, and a truce party will come to collect him under a flag of parley: hand him over (your wardens will see to it), and the silver is yours.
Refuse, and he stays your prisoner.

Or take his head - and live with what follows.
LanguageData.RimSiege_EnvoysComing: A truce party from {0} is on its way to collect {1}.
LanguageData.RimSiege_RansomPaid: The ransom is paid: {0} silver. {1} is going home.
LanguageData.RimSiege_RansomFailed: The envoys have left without their captain. The offer is dead.
LanguageData.RimSiege_EnvoysBetrayed: The truce party was attacked under the white flag. Word of this will spread.
LanguageData.RimSiege_VendettaText: {0} has sworn vengeance for {1}. They will come, and they will not parley.
LanguageData.RimSiege_VendettaHint: This host marches to avenge {0}. They did not come to talk.
LanguageData.RimSiege_CaptainDiedCustody: {0} has died in your custody. {1} holds you responsible.
LanguageData.RimSiege_CaptainFreed: You freed {0} and asked for nothing. {1} will remember the gesture, for a time.
LanguageData.RimSiege_FlingOption: Catapult him over the walls ({0} does the honors)
LanguageData.RimSiege_Flung: {0} is sent sailing over the walls.
LanguageData.RimSiege_ExecutionOrdered: {0} marches to execute {1}. The drums begin.
LanguageData.RimSiege_CaptainExecuted: {0} has been executed. {1} will not forget.
LanguageData.RimSiege_SetUltimatumTip: The besiegers demand a tribute before attacking. Unchecked: the siege launches immediately.
LanguageData.RimSiege_SetReinforceTip: Halfway through the bombardment a second column arrives and joins the camp, about a third of the original host. Waiting them out gets more expensive.
LanguageData.RimSiege_SetCarrionTip: The richest sieges (tarred boulder threshold + 2000 points) fling rotting carcasses over your walls: stench clouds, a corpse to haul away, and a chance of plague for anyone near the impact. Uncheck if that's too grim for your colony.
LanguageData.RimSiege_SetWarband: Siege warband size: x{0} threat points
LanguageData.RimSiege_SetCaptainRoutTip: Killing the captain (gilded helm) before the breach makes the whole siege flee.
LanguageData.RimSiege_SetDanegeldTip: Pay a tribute and that faction will come back for more, at a higher price. Rout a siege and word spreads: a long respite before the next one.
LanguageData.RimSiege_SetRansomTip: Capture a siege captain alive and his house will offer silver to get him back. Execute him, betray the truce party or let him die in your jail, and they swear a vendetta: the next siege comes sooner, angrier, and without an ultimatum. Free him for nothing and they will leave your walls alone, for a time.
